name: charter-notes-go
description: The notes API in Go on Cloudflare Workers (workers-go, TinyGo), from a Huma contract (api/contract.go): auth, SSE and WebSocket streams, MCP, rate limits. npm run check is every local check; the steps are the scripts below, in the order you run them: each is charter-ts <step>, which reads charter.config.ts.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run spec:check && npm run test:native && npm run test:workerd
